topics.title: Dawson’s Creek Listener Frustrations
topics.summary: A group of listeners discuss the television show Dawson’s Creek, expressing annoyance with frequent commercial breaks and repetitive song usage. They debate aspects of the show like Cody's behavior, teenage angst tropes, and celebrity scandals involving relationships, often repeating questions and struggling to identify specific musical cues.

topics.title: OJ Golf, John Lovitz & Tyra Banks
topics.summary: During a broadcast segment, Howard and Robin discuss rumors surrounding O.J. Simpson’s golf outing in Las Vegas with his wife Mary McCormick and a brief encounter with Tyra Banks. They also engage in awkward conversations about phone calls with a fan named John Lovitz, including speculation regarding his behavior and personal anecdotes like working as a telephone operator for one of the wives.

topics.title: Nickelodeon Interview – Vibrating Panties
topics.summary: During a chaotic Nickelodeon interview, hosts discuss worst school subjects (P.E.), awkward hero choices and the discomfort of wearing vibrating panties. They involve guests like Tyra Banks and Keith Hernandez, exploring urination habits and remote-controlled underwear, leading to humorous confusion.

topics.title: Vibrating Panties and Roseanne's New Romance
topics.summary: During a phone-in segment, listeners discuss the unusual situation of Roseanne dating Alan Steven while simultaneously engaging in an explicit conversation about vibrating panties. The discussion includes speculation on Alan’s past relationships with Sam Kennison and other callers share their thoughts on this bizarre topic.

topics.title: Nominee Calls In, Awards Drama
topics.summary: Bobby Duval announces his Best Actor nomination while discussing the Academy Award nominations with co-hosts. Dustin Hoffman reflects on youthful lack of concern about critical reception and a dating scandal involving Richard Lewis and Betty White. Alan Steven is also nominated, followed by Julianne Moore’s win for ‘Boogie Nights.’ Security Council resolution 687 addresses Iraq's threat, an American Airlines jet suffers a landing mishap, and the mayor of New York criticizes the Grammys.

topics.title: Mayor’s Toughness and a Cheating Wife – Dog Stories
topics.summary: Howard repeatedly criticizes the mayor for his perceived stubbornness and refusal to take responsibility regarding Michael Green's apology. He then engages in an unusual conversation with Crystal about her husband’s infidelity, including details of a dog retrieving phones, leading to speculation about marital problems. Finally, they discuss Louise Woodward’s legal situation and dwindling funds while reporting on the Epen family expecting another child.
